risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/payment/** per risk-map; no ledger or balance write in this task). Real collection channel adapters (BR-PAY-03 / 04 / 05 / 06 / 08 / 09): WechatPayChannel (APIv3 request signing, response verification, APP order, launch signature, query, close then re-query, refund, refund query, notification verification and AES-256-GCM decryption, bill request and download with SHA1 check) and AlipayPayChannel (signed orderStr, query, close then re-query, refund, refund query bound to out_request_no, notification verification, bill URL and download). Results are ok or unknown only. Bill files are not parsed (formats undocumented, bill_format_unverified; recon skips, D10-549 ④). PAY_* config read by api, worker and admin only (D10-549 ②); prod reads no key file until the KMS adapter exists (D10-554: kms_unavailable, orders 50306); non-prod needs PAY_WECHAT_TEST_MERCHANT=1 or an explicit non-production PAY_ALIPAY_GATEWAY (D10-549 ③); staging compose keeps PAY_CHANNEL_IMPL: fake (D10-549 ⑥). NOTHING here ran against a real merchant: CAP-X-16 / X-17 stay unverified, the error maps are all verified=no, and specs/pay-channels-launch-checklist.md lists what must be measured before any switch opens. Accepted residual (orchestrator 22:07): an unsigned-order signed not-found answer can be replayed by a man in the middle on TLS. Ported from task/PAY-01 d165566 without the transfer code; PAY review round 3 checked item by item by a fresh Claude (B2-15k/r3-checklist-review.json). Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, claude-opus-5-5, approvals #36), two rounds, plus [AC-B2-15k#1504] changed for D10-554 by another fresh Claude. Implementation by a Claude Opus 5.5 subagent (high reasoning, orchestrator 2026-11-01). Orchestrated by pay-acct5 (Claude Opus 5.5). Ledger #1187, #2169.
